blocks.text: A useful website begins with a clear purpose. This sample article demonstrates a complete editorial structure that can be adapted to a real project.
Write down the question your audience needs answered. Use a short introduction, meaningful headings and examples that make the next step clear.
Clarity is a practical design decision: every element should help someone understand or act.
